clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the Forbes 400 list is not what you think it is.

Two men were arrested in Asia holding a Bitcoin wallet worth over 17 billion dollars. Another man had over 50 billion dollars in cash in a crypto wallet. Neither one shows up on the Forbes list.

It gets stranger. Norway's sovereign wealth fund holds two trillion dollars, and nobody outside a small circle knows who actually controls it. Same with the Saudi fund, 1.7 trillion. Nobody knows who runs the International Monetary Fund or the World Bank either.

The richest people on the planet were never meant to be on a public list.
